# ComfyUI_Swap_and_Scale
--- ## ✨ Features - 🔗 Swap width with height - Limit output widht and height to a total of 1 Megapixel (usefull for certain model) - Resize width and height to factors of 32 which is usefull for new images, not so for existing. --- ## 🔧 Installation (Use ComfyUI customnode manager or clone this repo) 1. Clone or download this repo into your `ComfyUI/custom_nodes` directory: ``` cd /workspace/ComfyUI/custom_nodes git clone https://github.com/MijnSpam/ComfyUI_SwapAndScale.git ``` 2. Install dependencies: ``` no dependencies, all build-in python functions. ``` 3. Restart ComfyUI (or use the **Reload Custom Nodes** button if available). 4. Refesh browser. --- ## 🧩 How to Use Add node to workflow and connect a widht and heigth to the field. In ComfyUI: ![ComfyUI Node](images/Example1.png) 1. example explanation: - `1`: Swap Width_Height is on and as you see the out_height is swapped with the width. - `2`: example input image had dimensions 1344x752 >> 752 /32 = 23.5 and so with the factor_32px it's resize to 736. - `3`: Total pixels (W*H) is below 1024000 px so no scaling done ![ComfyUI Node](images/Example2.png) 2. example explanation:
- `1`: NO Swap Width_Height, however 1MP and factor32 is on.
Width 1504 / 32 = 47, Height 2720 / 32 = 85 >> ratio (w/h 0.552) scaled ratio 736 / 1344 = 0.547
_Not perfect but it respects the 1MP Limit with the 32px rule._ --- ## 🧑‍💻 Contributing Pull requests and feature ideas are welcome! Feel free to fork and create a PR. --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the MIT License. See [LICENSE](./LICENSE) for details. ## Other custom nodes (search for "KB comfy" in manager) - Upload to Pushover ## Changelog 1.0.2 Trying to fix update when using comfy custom node manger 1.0.1 Fixed fault in 1MP resolution, no it actually uses 1024*1024

# SwapAndScale V2 conversion

Upstream: https://github.com/MijnSpam/ComfyUI_SwapAndScale at
`8bcdf7d9371fe774ac144ebe11748e261b4380bf`. All nine pristine Git blobs are retained.

Purpose: round dimensions to multiples of32, optionally limit their product to
1,048,576 pixels with the original proportional rounding, then optionally swap them.
The four original computation methods are textually and structurally unchanged.
The actual node module moves out of package __init__ so a Guest can import its
defining module without depending on ancestor package initialization.

Original node/class/display/category, five input names/order, Boolean defaults,
two INT outputs and names, and OUTPUT_NODE=True are preserved. The two original
INT declarations have no authored default or bounds; none are added. SDK_REFS is
False for plain integers and booleans; SDK_PERMISSIONS is empty. No SDK extension,
filesystem, network, model, tensor or live-object operation is required.

The checked-in API declaration bytes are the existing genuine contract from the
qualified f1 profile, copied from the verified RandomSeed publication. This source
preparation did not generate a manifest or run a new stub generator. Actual normal
manifest generation, original/SDK comparisons, Guest execution, canonical pair and
pristine replays, source publication and registry admission remain pending.

Required differential coverage includes all eight Boolean flag combinations,
asymmetric dimensions, values around multiples of32 and the1MP boundary, zero,
negative and large integer behavior, original error cases, exact output order/type,
schema/default/output-node preservation and deliberate incorrect-result controls.
Passing source checks are not behavioral or whole-pack acceptance.
